subject: Business Models
title: Platform Rules and Trust
description: A micro-lesson that makes Platform Rules and Trust usable.

hook.text: Airbnb reviews seem simple. But without them, strangers would never sleep in each other's homes.

buildup.text: Platforms must create trust between strangers. Reviews, ratings, and verification systems do the heavy lifting.

discovery.text: eBay's feedback system turned anonymous internet strangers into trusted trading partners in the late 1990s.

twist.text: Fake reviews are a billion-dollar industry. Amazon removes millions yearly, but new ones appear daily.

climax.text: Trust is a platform's most valuable and fragile asset. Lose it, and both sides flee.

punchline.text: Stars build trust. Fake stars destroy it. Governance matters.

quiz.question: Why are review systems critical for platform businesses?

details.summary: Platform governance establishes the rules, ratings, and dispute resolution systems that create trust between strangers transacting on a platform. Review systems, identity verification, and standardized policies reduce the risk of each interaction and enable commerce at scale.
details.whyItMatters: Trust is the essential enabler of platform commerce. Without governance mechanisms that make strangers comfortable transacting, platforms cannot function. Building and maintaining trust systems is a core platform competency.
takeaways: Review and rating systems create accountability through reputation
Identity verification reduces fraud and increases transaction confidence
Dispute resolution mechanisms protect both sides when transactions go wrong

faq.question: How do reputation systems create trust between strangers on platforms?
faq.answer: Public ratings and reviews create accountability because participants know their behavior will be visible to future counterparts. Repeated positive interactions build reputation capital that economic incentives motivate participants to protect through good behavior.

faq.question: What happens when platform trust systems fail?
faq.answer: Fraud increases, quality declines, high-value participants leave, and the platform enters a death spiral of declining trust. Fake reviews on Amazon, scams on Craigslist, and safety incidents on Airbnb all demonstrate how trust failures can threaten platform viability.
